title: fix(app-shell): the Studio flow screen preview carries every field key the runtime renders — options, placeholder, and defaultValue shown literally (objectui#11190)
body:
Fixes #11190
Clause-②: no

## What was wrong

The Studio flow screen preview (`ScreenPreview`) renders through the same `ScreenView` the flow runner uses, but it first builds the screen from the node's authored config (`buildScreenSpec` → `toScreenFields` in `previews/screen-spec.ts`). That projection kept `name`, `label`, `type`, `required`, `visibleWhen` and the four keys PR objectui#11188 carried, and dropped `options`, `placeholder` and `defaultValue`.

Measured once on `origin/main` `846cec0ef` (one-shot probe, not committed), with objectstack `examples/app-todo`'s `screen_1` fields plus one text field with a `placeholder`:

- preview: `combobox 0 | textbox 4 | placeholder 0`
- runtime `ScreenView` on the same rows: `combobox 2 | textbox 2 | placeholder 1`

## What `ScreenView` reads

Measured with a one-shot probe that wrapped each field in a `Proxy` and recorded every property read while `ScreenView` rendered six control variants (lookup, select, checkbox, textarea, number, text), plus `initialScreenValues` and `screenFieldBoundViolations`. The set it read: `defaultValue`, `inlineHelpText`, `label`, `max`, `min`, `name`, `options`, `placeholder`, `reference`, `required`, `type`, `visibleWhen`. That is every key of the spec's `ScreenFieldSpec` (`@objectstack/spec/contracts` 17.5.0), which `ScreenView` re-exports verbatim and types its field prop with.

## The change

- **One list, derived from the spec type.** `toScreenFields` now runs one table, `SCREEN_FIELD_CARRY`, typed as a mapped type over every key of `ScreenFieldSpec` with the `-?` modifier. Each entry says how that key is carried: the value when it holds the type the spec declares, else nothing (the existing "a half-typed row adds nothing" rule). There is no second key list. A key the spec adds fails `@object-ui/app-shell`'s type-check at the table until the preview says how to carry it; an entry that is removed fails it too.
- `options` is carried when every entry is an object with a string `label` (the spec's option shape; `value` is `unknown` there). `placeholder` is a string. `defaultValue` is anything but absent, `null` included, as the executor forwards it. `required` stays always stated, as before.
- **`defaultValue` is shown as written, with a marker** (triage ruling). The preview seeds the control with the literal, as `initialScreenValues` does. For each visible field whose `defaultValue` holds a `{…}` reference, a **hint line** under the form names the field and shows the template in a code span. The text is localized (`engine.screenPreview.defaultTemplate`, en and zh rows). A default with no reference, such as app-todo's `'normal'`, is what the run shows too, so it gets no line. The reference grammar is the one `interpolate` in the same module already substitutes, now a shared constant, so "is a template" and "what the preview substitutes" read one grammar. The preview never interpolates a default, even when `variables` holds a value (the Debug pause included).
- `ScreenPreview`'s re-seed key now includes each field's `defaultValue`. The form is seeded once, at mount, so without this an edited default in the inspector would not reach the preview.

## Pins (`ScreenPreview.fieldProjection-11190.test.tsx`)

- app-todo's `screen_1` fields, field for field as they stand at objectstack `0f6dcac5e9`, render two comboboxes (`ff-priority`, `ff-category`) in the preview. `ScreenView` on the executor's wire shape for the same rows renders the same two, and `Priority` shows `Normal` in both.
- A `placeholder` shows.
- A `defaultValue` template shows as written in the text box even with `variables` supplied, and its marker line names the field and shows the template in a code span. A second case covers zh and a `date` field whose control cannot display the literal.
- Control: a key-less field is a bare text box with no placeholder and no marker. Also measured once, not committed: the preview HTML for five key-less fields (plain, number+required, textarea, boolean with `visibleWhen`, text gated on it) is byte-identical at `846cec0ef` and at `f2c393e9d` (3329 bytes each, `cmp` equal).
- A row typed as `Required` over `ScreenFieldSpec` (every key made mandatory, so a new spec key also fails the test type-check), every key populated, comes out of `buildScreenSpec` `toStrictEqual` to itself. A half-typed `options` / `placeholder` is not carried, and a `null` default is.

## Ablation and reverse verification (one-shot, run after the fix was committed)

- **Ablation: drop `options` from the table** (`ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor `  options: carryOptions,` hit 1 → 0, blob `079eaa7172ce` → `500514a963ab`). Result: vitest `2 failed | 5 passed (7)`. The app-todo combobox pin and the full-row pin went red. `tsc --noEmit` exit 2 with `TS2741: Property 'options' is missing ... but required in type 'ScreenFieldCarry'`. Restored: blob equal to HEAD `079eaa7172ce`, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- **A future spec key**: a throwaway module augmentation added `futureKey?: string` to `ScreenFieldSpec`. `tsc --noEmit` then exits 2 with `TS2741: Property 'futureKey' is missing ... but required in type 'ScreenFieldCarry'`. The probe file was removed and the tree is clean.

## Verification

The branch merges `origin/main` at `0389650f3` (head `f370557a3`; the merge touched none of this change's files). Measured at `f370557a3`:

- `pnpm exec vitest run` over `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/`, `packages/app-shell/src/views/ScreenView*`, `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/FlowNodeInspector*`, the three `packages/i18n` suites that read the designer table, and nine `scripts/__tests__` members that read `.changeset/` or the designer table: `Test Files 112 passed (112)`, `Tests 1819 passed (1819)`.
- The `@object-ui/app-shell` dependency closure was built with turbo first (`28 successful`), then `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`): exit 0. `tsconfig.test.json --listFilesOnly` includes the new pin.
- `pnpm exec eslint` on the four changed source and test files: 4 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings. The linted population is `**/*.{ts,tsx}` minus the config's ignores, and the JSON output counts 4 files. The config enables no type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project` or `projectService`), and no custom rule reads the disk, so this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file.
- Gates, exit 0: `check-changeset-presence`, `check-control-bytes`, `check-new-cross-file-line-citations` (0 new), `check-i18n-call-site-keys`, `check-i18n-designer-table-parity`, `check-i18n-en-drift`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-changeset-overwrite`, `check-pending-changeset-literals`, `markdown-test-inputs --audit`.

Measured at `f2c393e9d`, before the merge:

- The whole root `scripts/__tests__/` suite: `Test Files 177 passed | 2 skipped (179)`, `Tests 5371 passed | 2 skipped (5373)`.
- `check-changeset-claims`, `check-changeset-fixed` and `check-i18n-dead-keys` (a report), exit 0.

NOT MEASURED: the full `packages/app-shell/src/views/` directory (602 test files). Reason: it timed out at the 520s foreground cap on the shared box (exit 124). It is left to CI.

## Acceptance notes

- The claim's file surface names `screen-spec.ts`, `ScreenPreview.tsx`, pins and a changeset. The order also requires the marker's text to be localized, and that text can only live in the designer table, so `metadata-admin/i18n.ts` gains one en row and one zh row.
- In the Debug run's paused screen, the title and description still interpolate against the live values (`interpolate`), while a `defaultValue` template shows as written, per the ruling. Carrier: none.
- `ScreenView` falls back to a hard-coded English `Select…` for a select with no `placeholder`. The preview now shows it too, under a zh designer, beside its localized words. The runtime dialog has always shown it. Polish, not filed. Carrier: none.
- An `options` list with one half-typed entry (for example a row whose `label` is still empty in the inspector, which the designer drops) is not carried, so the field shows as a text box until the entry is complete.
- `Spec Main Shape Gate`: its repair (objectui#11206) is on `main` and comes into this branch through the merge above. This PR does not touch that gate's files.
